description: This file contains Perl code for generating optimized assembly routines for GHASH and related cryptographic operations on x86_64, including AVX and CLMUL implementations, with detailed comments and performance notes.

methods.name: clmul64x64_T2
methods.description: Performs 64x64 bit carry-less multiplication using CLMUL, with optional shared table input.

methods.name: reduction_alg9
methods.description: Performs polynomial reduction in GF(2^128) optimized for performance.

methods.name: gcm_init_clmul
methods.description: Initializes GHASH context with CLMUL instructions, precomputing powers of H.

methods.name: gcm_gmult_clmul
methods.description: Performs GHASH multiplication using CLMUL instructions.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_clmul
methods.description: Computes GHASH over input data using CLMUL instructions.

methods.name: gcm_init_avx
methods.description: Initializes GHASH context with AVX instructions, precomputing powers of H.

methods.name: gcm_gmult_avx
methods.description: Performs GHASH multiplication using AVX instructions.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_avx
methods.description: Computes GHASH over input data using AVX instructions.
